title: Mexican Roast Chicken Tacos
description: A flavorful and spicy dish featuring roasted chicken, served in tacos with your choice of toppings.
instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the lime juice, cumin, cayenne pepper, and oregano.
Rub the mixture all over the chicken, then place it in a baking dish.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
While the chicken is cooking, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add a tablespoon of oil to the skillet and sauté the diced peppers until they are tender.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
Warm tacos shells according to the package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by placing a few slices of the roasted chicken onto a shell, then topping with the sautéed peppers, diced avocado, and a sprinkle of cilantro.
